name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses and children of a foreign national legally residing in Syria (on work, business, or other grounds) may apply for a family reunification residence permit, typically issued for up to 1 year and extendable in line with the sponsor's own permit. The sponsor must show financial-support documentation and proof of the family relationship.
requirements.fix_path: Apply with proof of the family relationship and the sponsor's financial-support documentation and valid residence status.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of parent-child relationship
Sponsor's proof of financial support and valid residence status

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, tied to the sponsor's own residence permit

sources.title: LawGratis (private legal-guide site) -- describes a family reunification visa/residence category for spouses and children of legally resident foreign nationals, tied to the sponsor's own status

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Syria). STATUS: DRAFT -- thinnest sourcing tier in this build (a single tier-4 private legal-guide site; no government portal located). This route describes reunification for FOREIGN dependents joining a foreign sponsor already resident in Syria on other grounds (work/business), not a route for foreign spouses of Syrian citizens specifically -- that distinct, more consequential pathway (Syrian-citizen sponsor) was not separately documented in any source found in this build and is not asserted here. Given Syria's current reconstruction-era institutional instability, this route should be treated as indicative of general practice rather than a confirmed, stable legal category.
